Sources.statement: Ryzen AI 1.8 installation instructions publish NPU driver 32.0.203.376 as production for Phoenix, Hawk Point, Strix, Strix Halo, and Krackan Point.
Ryzen AI 1.5 supports Phoenix, Hawk Point, Strix, Strix Halo, and Krackan Point.
AMD npu_check encodes Ryzen AI software minimum driver versions through 1.8.

ROG Xbox Ally X with AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme exposed NPU PCI 1022:17F0 REV_10, XRT device name NPU Strix, firmware 1.1.2.64, and AMD 376 runtime components whose INF/ipustack/xrt-smi hashes exactly match the reviewed public 376 artifact.
Reviewed AMD quicktest.py classifies PCI DEV_17F0 REV_00/10/11 as STX and REV_20 as KRK. The file is evidence only and is not executed by the research toolkit.
